detail.title: META Pencil 100 Passive Stylus - No Charging Needed, White
detail.overview: The Ant META Pencil 100 is a straightforward passive stylus for iPad, iPhone, Android tablets and smartphones, built for everyday writing, note-taking, drawing and signatures without ever needing to be charged. A precision disc tip gives accurate touch response on most capacitive touchscreens, while the sturdy aluminium body adds durability and a premium, comfortable feel in hand. A magnetic cap keeps the tip protected and the pen easy to find when not in use, making it a simple, no-fuss stylus for anyone who wants reliable everyday performance without battery management.
